requirement: The core shall implement every RV32I integer instruction and every RV32M operation in the declared unprivileged execution environment.
The core shall implement x0=0, little-endian loads/stores, signed/unsigned extensions, and precise alignment/illegal-instruction fail-stop trap outputs.
Unsupported C/A/F/D/Zicsr/Zifencei and privileged features shall be explicitly declared and never claimed as verified.
Each SRAM word shall store 32 data bits plus 7 SECDED bits; all single-bit positions shall correct and all double-bit pairs shall detect.
SRAM shall check and correct data before use and write corrected codewords back without a race with a foreground partial write.
Detected uncorrectable load/read or partial-RMW data shall not be consumed or written as a new valid codeword.
Background scrub arbitration shall have a specified worst-case service interval under continuous foreground traffic.
verification: future saturation test and timing analysis

requirement: Physical codeword interleaving and any stronger ECC shall be selected using target multi-cell-upset data.
ECC initialization and boot-memory contents shall be valid before processor release from reset.
verification: simulation loader tested; physical boot sequencer not implemented

requirement: A static RF_TMR parameter shall select either 39-bit SECDED words or three independent 32-bit register replicas.
verification: cocotb ecc/tmr build matrix; synthesis audit

requirement: ECC mode shall correct operands before use and repair every nonzero register within 31 background-scrub clocks.
TMR mode shall vote operands and repair all replicas after any one replica-bit upset, including x0 restoration.
TMR mode shall declare two-replica identical corruption outside the guaranteed correction model rather than claiming detection.
PC, instruction, pending transaction, watchdog, halt/fault status and RF scrub pointer shall have triplicated voted state with repair feedback.
The CPU FSM shall use explicit distance-four encodings and halt on an invalid voted state; correction shall be attributed to TMR, not to nonexistent Hamming decoding.
RAM response, error/fatal state and scrub pointer shall be triplicated and repaired.
Every sequential controller and stateful helper shall appear in a protection inventory, including newly added blocks.
Two execution decision records shall agree before architectural writes or memory requests derived from execution are authorized.
Shared decode/voter/commit logic and address-selection common modes shall be closed with target-specific mitigation before a radiation-tolerance claim.
verification: netlist fault injection and physical implementation

requirement: The reference receiver shall reject detected bad address/control/write-data codewords and out-of-range requests without committing a store.
Requests shall be serialized and stalled transactions shall trigger a bounded fail-stop timeout.
Detector observations shall produce sticky source flags and saturating corrected/uncorrectable/disagreement/fatal counters.
The recorder shall preserve first and last observation PC/address/flags, retaining the first record until reset.
Recorder state shall be triplicated with repair and shall report its own replica disagreement.
verification: protected_state_and_reporting all recorder bits; synthesis audit

requirement: Simultaneous-event metadata priority, repeated-detection counting, record loss, reset behavior and counter saturation shall be explicitly specified.
Production FI_ENABLE=0 builds shall acknowledge no injection and retain normal behavior even if fault ports toggle.
Test builds shall expose deterministic clock-edge XOR injection for stored SRAM/RF/control/report state, with bounded indices and acknowledgement.
Fault campaigns shall record mode, target, index, bit mask, expected outcome, and actual pass/fail with reproducible stimulus.
verification: build/fault_results_*.json; JUnit XML; source deterministic order

requirement: No fault campaign shall describe stored-bit injection as validation of analog SET pulse widths, multiple-node strike coverage or clock/reset susceptibility.
Upstream code shall be fetched at immutable commits specified by a lockfile; dirty or mismatched checkouts shall be rejected.
cocotb shall run upstream instruction/workload tests and fault campaigns in both register modes, with bounded test timeouts and nonzero failure exit status.
Synthesis shall preserve and audit separate sequential drivers for CPU/RAM/report TMR state and optional RF replicas, plus distinct execution instances.
Radiation qualification shall require target implementation, timing/CDC/reset analysis, representative irradiation and a mission-level residual error/outage budget.
The project shall fetch formal sources at immutable commits and verify downloaded tool archives against SHA256 before execution.
The ECC encoder/decoder shall have a combinational proof covering all data values and all single/double stored-bit faults.
The error monitor shall have inductive checks for sticky observations, exact saturating counts, first/last records and repair of one corrupted replica.
ISA checks shall use an optional RVFI interface and the pinned upstream RV32IM models; real M arithmetic shall not be silently replaced by ALTOPS.
Core and RAM fault harnesses shall state injection multiplicity, permitted locations, environment assumptions and cycle bounds.
Every formal campaign shall retain per-job outcomes and counterexamples; FAIL, UNKNOWN, ERROR and TIMEOUT shall fail the command.
Reachability covers shall accompany directed fault scenarios and instruction checks to identify vacuous configurations.
Whole-core instruction and single-upset containment checks shall complete without unresolved jobs before whole-core formal verification is claimed.
Bus/memory consistency, unbounded progress, completeness of decoded ISA coverage and equivalence with RVFI disabled shall be separately verified before broader certification claims.
The KC705 target shall declare the verified board pin facts, clock conversion, FPGA part and initialization image configuration.
The FPGA build shall preserve named replica groups and execution lanes and reject failed timing or error-level DRC before bitstream generation.
Clock/reset and every board diagnostic controller shall be included in the protection inventory with their laboratory-only unprotected scope.
The KC705 target shall complete synthesis, implementation, timing closure and on-board bring-up before operational FPGA support is claimed.
